items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in weekend injury summary for Week 7.
items.why: ETR weekend summary; high-ankle sprain ongoing.
items.implication: Ravens without starting QB; Huntley or backup elevated.
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming; Ravens skill players volume shift possible.

items.text: Puka Nacua moved from GTD/OPTIMISM to ACTIVE vs Raiders.
items.why: ETR summary; Schefter confirmed official active with calf improvement.
items.implication: Full or near-full WR1 role expected.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets lead in LAR offense; reverse any Whittington/Atwell stashes.

items.text: Breece Hall from GTD/PESSIMISM to INACTIVE; Allen handled ground work.
items.implication: Braelon Allen/Isaiah Davis full backfield opportunity.
items.opportunity: Handcuff elevation; monitor Week 8 practice for return.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY then confirmed ACTIVE for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.why: ETR pregame; Schefter/RapSheet confirmed active with Eagles inactives.
items.implication: Lead back role intact despite prior uncertainty.
items.opportunity: Snaps/carries/RZ primary; reverse any backup elevation.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; Dobbins only 21% snaps. RJ Harvey flukey TD.
items.why: Snap/rush/route lead post-return confirms preseason thesis.
items.implication: Broncos RB1 going forward; roster in all formats.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch thesis: worst runner efficiency but RB13 PPR PPG via 9 carries inside 5 and league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: RZ/goal-line volume + target lead offsets poor YPC/EPA.
items.implication: Sustainable floor via opportunity despite efficiency; hold/buy.
items.opportunity: High HVT/RZ/target share continues; efficiency regression possible but role locked.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 of 36 routes in second game without Rashee Rice; historical note never topped 83 rec yards in 37 games.
items.why: Route monopoly without Rice; ceiling caution from career high.
items.implication: WR1 opportunity while Rice out (hamstring); monitor efficiency.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets; pair with Mahomes for ceiling.
items.conflict: Historical production lag vs current volume.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turn on purposeful slide: almost certainly fine. Coach and player confirm pain gone, should be good.
items.why: Levitan assessment post-ETR watch list; Campbell/Gibbs comments corroborate no significant issue.
items.implication: No missed time expected; full workload Week 8.
items.opportunity: Maintain RB1 ranking; no handcuff panic.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT.
items.why: ETR summary; hamstring for Smith, related for Wicks.
items.implication: Eagles WR corps thinned; targets to Goedert, Lemon, others.
items.opportunity: Increased routes for remaining pass-catchers including rookie TE Stowers activated.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated and expected to play.
items.why: ETR IN list; Schefter activation confirmation.
items.implication: Packers RB1 role return; monitor share vs Lloyd/Wilson.

items.text: Put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name; strong call post-Week 7 production.
items.why: Consistent WR2/1 upside with Burrow; undervalued narrative.
items.implication: Start with confidence; buy-low if available.
items.opportunity: Target share/RZ with Chase; Bengals pass volume.

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; sell-high opportunity if possible.
items.why: Big game after prior inconsistency; capitalize on peak value.
items.implication: Trade for more consistent asset; Titans RB committee risk.
items.opportunity: Usage may not sustain; monitor next reports.

items.text: Texans routes: Nico Collins 24 lead on 29 dropbacks; Tank Dell only 6 in first game back since 2024; Noel left early turf toe.
items.why: Collins clear route lead; Dell limited return; Noel turf toe.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell ramp slow; bye helps Noel.
items.opportunity: Collins target share; Dell handcuff/monitor only.

items.text: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) actually hurt but not certain of severity; watching with Tracy.
items.why: Levitan player-specific read on ETR injury watch.
items.implication: Potential missed time; NYG RB depth test.
items.opportunity: Handcuff or Tracy elevation if OUT.
